QuestInfo.0:
Use the Hidden Entrance in #r#m450005220##k to follow the #bSmall Spirit#k.

A tree that loves sound appears to have grown and blocked off the Bramble Harp's vital starlight. What should you do?

Talk to the #bSmall Spirit#k in #r#m940200216##k and discuss what to do.
QuestInfo.1:
Use #b#i4036099:# #t4036099:##k items gathered from #r#o8644005##k monsters to try and coax the tree into moving. Around #r50#k should be enough.

Return to the #rSmall Spirit#k in #b#m940200216##k after you've gathered the materials.
QuestInfo.2: It seems the noise from the #t4036099:# items was not enough.

0.0: If we made enough noise on the opposite side of the tree, maybe we could coax the leaves into moving in that direction.
0.1: But what could we possibly use to make enough sound? Hmm, perhaps the crystalized screams of Toxic Spirits would do.
